hikes.name: Enchanted Valley
hikes.blurb: The long walk up the East Fork Quinault to the Valley of 10,000 Waterfalls and a 1930s chalet under sheer cliffs.

hikes.name: Colonel Bob Mountain
hikes.blurb: A big climb from rain forest to a rocky summit with Lake Quinault and the ocean below.

hikes.name: Pony Bridge
hikes.blurb: Through big trees to a bridge over a narrow, swirling gorge of the East Fork Quinault.

hikes.name: Rose Lake
hikes.blurb: From Skokomish Wildlife Area, a 6.7-mile round trip to Rose Lake, with about 700 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Stevens Lake
hikes.blurb: From Skokomish Wildlife Area, an 8.0-mile round trip to Stevens Lake, with about 700 feet of climbing.
